reasoning: The icon shows an upright half-bone with one flat end and one bi-lobed joint end. It fits tasks centered on dog chew bones, orthopedic/bone health (fractures, DEXA scans), anatomy, or making bone broth, though its flat top makes it slightly less recognizable than a classic double-ended bone and somewhat similar to an hourglass or earbud stem.

pass1.ambiguity: Because the top end is flat rather than bi-lobed like a classic cartoon dog bone, it can be mistaken at small sizes for a keyhole, an hourglass, a chess pawn, a bollard, or a single wireless earbud.
